note: Forbidden behaviour: accepting an IP Internal Reachability (TLV 128) prefix whose metric-type bit says external. TestRFC2966InvalidInternalExternalMetricExcluded sets bit 0x40 on the TLV 128 entry of the cheaper route and requires metricWinner to pick the dearer valid route (id 2, 160); clearing the bit requires the cheap route back (id 3, 2), so both an accept-anyway and a drop-everything implementation go red.
